translations.pricing-page.hero.title: Free to create. {$START_TAG_SPAN}Pay to keep.{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.pricing-page.hero.description: Draft your whole business for free. Pay only for the final version of what you keep, then pennies a day to keep it running. One wallet for all IDEM services, topped up by mobile money from 100 F.
translations.pricing-page.hero.note: No card, no payment number. 7 days of IDEM Growth offered at signup.
translations.pricing-page.steps.title: Four verbs, one wallet
translations.pricing-page.steps.create.title: Create
translations.pricing-page.steps.create.text: Business plan, logo, pitch deck, statutes, website: everything in draft, with no time limit.
translations.pricing-page.steps.keep.title: Keep
translations.pricing-page.steps.keep.text: Unlock the final version of what you use. The whole Business Kit never costs more than 2,500 F per project.
translations.pricing-page.steps.run.title: Run
translations.pricing-page.steps.run.text: Your site online, your monthly content, your app: paid by the day or by the piece, capped every month.
translations.pricing-page.steps.grow.title: Grow
translations.pricing-page.steps.grow.text: Sell online with mobile money: IDEM takes a small commission only when you get paid.
translations.pricing-page.kit.title: Keep: the final version, capped at the Kit
translations.pricing-page.kit.description: The final version adds sourced market data, a professional layout, files without the IDEM mark and 30 days of free edits. Buy only what you need: once your purchases on a project reach 2,500 F, the rest of the Kit is unlocked at no extra cost.
translations.pricing-page.kit.signature: Signature version: +1,000 F per deliverable, written and laid out by the most powerful models.
translations.pricing-page.kit.anchor: The same Kit costs 500,000 to 1,000,000 F with a consultant, a designer and a lawyer.
translations.pricing-page.d.bp: Business plan with sourced market data
translations.pricing-page.run.title: Run: a little every month, never more than the cap
translations.pricing-page.comm.title: Communication
translations.pricing-page.comm.description: Pay per piece. Your purchases of the month stop at 3,000 F: beyond that, IDEM Growth is yours until the end of the month.
translations.pricing-page.passes.title: Monthly plans
translations.pricing-page.passes.croissance.name: IDEM Growth
translations.pricing-page.passes.croissance.text: Unlimited communication (fair use), unlimited edits on every deliverable, showcase site always on, 20 iCode changes per month, one simulation per quarter.
translations.pricing-page.passes.entreprise.name: IDEM Business
translations.pricing-page.passes.entreprise.text: Everything in Growth, plus the iDeploy Application meter, iVision Creator and a domain included with the yearly plan.
translations.pricing-page.passes.createur.name: iVision Creator
translations.pricing-page.passes.createur.text: Every iVision HD export included (fair use: 60 visuals, 6 videos per month).
translations.pricing-page.icode.title: iCode — generating is free, owning costs almost nothing
translations.pricing-page.icode.generate: Generate your app and watch it run
translations.pricing-page.icode.pass: Project Pass — code, GitHub, one-click deploy, 30 changes
translations.pricing-page.icode.premium: Change with the most powerful model
translations.pricing-page.ideploy.title: iDeploy — one application, one meter
translations.pricing-page.ideploy.description: Paid by the day from your wallet. No subscription: change meters whenever you like. An application left unpaid falls asleep, it is never deleted at once.
translations.pricing-page.ideploy.veille: Standby — site on yourproject.idem.africa, woken up on visit
translations.pricing-page.ideploy.options: Daily options: advanced firewall, auto-scaling, backups, monitoring, extra database, 90-day logs, static IP, national data residency — from 15 F/day.
translations.pricing-page.ideploy.domains: Domain names: .africa 6,500 F the first year (renewal 8,000 F), .com 8,900 F. At cost in the packs.
translations.pricing-page.ivision.title: iVision — signed for free, paid at export
translations.pricing-page.ivision.free: Visuals and videos marked “Made with iVision”
translations.pricing-page.ivision.visual: HD export without the mark: visual
translations.pricing-page.ivision.video: HD export without the mark: video
translations.pricing-page.sim.title: iSimulate — put your business to the test
translations.pricing-page.packs.title: Packs that bring everything together
translations.pricing-page.packs.lancement.name: Launch Pack
translations.pricing-page.packs.lancement.text: Business Kit + iCode Project Pass (30 changes) + 3 months of showcase site always on.
translations.pricing-page.packs.domaine.name: Launch Pack + domain
translations.pricing-page.packs.domaine.text: The Launch Pack and a .africa domain for one year, at cost.
translations.pricing-page.packs.plusieurs.name: Together
translations.pricing-page.packs.plusieurs.text: 5 Launch Packs to give away (the 5th is free): association, tontine, cooperative.
translations.pricing-page.wallet.title: The wallet
translations.pricing-page.wallet.text: Top up from 100 F by mobile money: +5% bonus from 5,000 F, +10% from 10,000 F. Outside the CFA franc zone, the price is set for your country.
translations.pricing-page.faq.title: Questions
translations.pricing-page.faq.q1: Why pay when ChatGPT is free?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a1: You do not pay to generate: drafts are free. You pay for a finished, sourced deliverable, laid out and ready for the bank, adapted to OHADA law and your country, and kept in one place with your brand.
translations.pricing-page.faq.a2: No. The monthly plans are optional, and your pay-as-you-go purchases stop at their price: you can never pay more than the plan.
translations.pricing-page.faq.q3: What happens if my wallet is empty?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a3: Your drafts stay available. A paid iDeploy application falls asleep after a reminder email; top up and it wakes up. Nothing is deleted.
